WITH window_reviews AS (
  SELECT r.review_score
  FROM reviews.order_reviews AS r
  JOIN orders.orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(r.review_creation_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2018-01-01'
    AND CAST(r.review_creation_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-02-01'
),
baseline_reviews AS (
  SELECT r.review_score
  FROM reviews.order_reviews AS r
  JOIN orders.orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(r.review_creation_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2017-12-01'
    AND CAST(r.review_creation_date AS DATE) < DATE '2018-01-01'
),
window_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score::DOUBLE), 4) AS value
  FROM window_reviews
),
baseline_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score::DOUBLE), 4) AS baseline
  FROM baseline_reviews
)
SELECT value, baseline FROM window_avg, baseline_avg;
